material_passport.scope: Four pilot_002 evaluation.jsonl files only; no GPU run or new sampling

primary_failure_policy: One primary cause per failed row: END/PAD validator, then CNL parse, decoded condition, geometry, physical audit, then edit-length/plan comparison. Errors raised by unpack_block for invalid model output are expected validation failures, not program exceptions.

raw_retention.hybrid_boundary_failures: 23 G and 23 E rows store only an error object, without a structured value.tokens ID array. Counts above use the stored error classification; no exact token-ID sequence is claimed.
raw_retention.hybrid_parse_failures: One G and one E row pass generation/unpack and retain a 2560-ID tokens array, then fail CNL decoding.
raw_retention.ar_heldout_replay: pilot_002 contains 16 replay rows with structured generation tokens. The predecessor had only 2 heldout raw rows; mp-1079976 was not recovered, and this replay is a new observation for that row and subsequent rows. Do not attribute it to the missing predecessor output.
raw_retention.failed_raw_caveat: Hybrid exception text may carry decoded output text, but the failed result has no structured token sequence; this audit does not reconstruct or quote generated token text.

training_curve.interpretation: The falling mixed training loss is not a generation accuracy metric. The hybrid objective predicts only masked positions; body, END and PAD share the crystal loss, with PAD weighted 0.1. No class-specific teacher-forced accuracy is recorded.

representative_cases.failure: END-count validator: crystal block requires exactly one END
PAD-boundary validator: invalid crystal PAD boundary
CNL decode: input cell sentence missing or malformed
CNL condition: orbit multiplicity and representative relations do not select one public definition
Geometry execution: expanded composition mismatch; current row is a new replay observation
Physical audit: minimum pair distance below 0.5 A; length also mismatches

next_diagnostic: If approved as a separate GPU diagnostic: use the same hybrid checkpoint and same 8 seen cases, with no optimizer updates; measure teacher-forced argmax accuracy separately for masked body, END and PAD positions at full-mask and an intermediate mask level, plus per-sequence argmax END count and exact PAD-boundary validity. This distinguishes weak boundary learning from reverse-unmask error propagation. Do not infer the cause from mixed loss alone.
q2_exposure_note: The Q2 exposure gap is separate and is not used to explain these G/E outcomes.
